title: Frankfurter Buchmesse 2025
summary: Our second Frankfurt stand, with a networking hour for publishing friends.
body:
Our second year with our own stand in Frankfurt, with a larger team, a full schedule of rights meetings and a networking hour at our stand on the fair’s second day.

[Read our report from the fair](/news/frankfurt-book-fair-2025/)
image_alt: The Epsilon Publishing Group team at our Frankfurt 2025 stand
seo_description: Epsilon Publishing Group at the Frankfurt Book Fair, 15–19 October 2025: rights meetings, new titles and a networking hour at its stand.
